heading: Travis Kelce's $7.35 million real estate portfolio includes a mansion and two former properties
author: Global Sports Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM / Updated: Sep 21, 2026, 16:26 IST
paragraphs: Travis Kelce's success with the Kansas City Chiefs has helped him build a real estate portfolio that stretches beyond the football field
From a luxury mansion in a gated Kansas City community to a Florida condo shared with his family, the NFL star has invested in properties that reflect his career and personal roots

His real estate journey also includes a major upgrade from his earlier Kansas City home.Travis Kelce's $6 million Kansas City mansion is his primary residenceFor travKelce, Kansas City has become much more than the place where he built his NFL career
It is also where he has established his home base.The Chiefs tight end's primary residence is a $6 million mansion in a gated community near Kansas City, according to Hello Magazine
The property offers a level of privacy and luxury that suits a player whose career has brought him considerable fame.However, this wasn't always Kelce's standard of living
Before moving into the upscale estate, he owned a seven-bedroom home in Kansas City's Briarcliff West neighbourhood
He purchased that property in 2019 for $995,000.The earlier house marked an important stage in his career

Kelce had already established himself as one of the NFL's leading tight ends, but his real estate choices would later reflect his growing financial success.His move to a more expensive home also highlights how his life has changed since entering the league

With multiple seasons of success in Kansas City, Kelce has built a strong connection to the city, making it a natural choice for his primary residence.The $6 million mansion remains the standout property associated with his personal real estate portfolio

Still, his property interests extend beyond Missouri.Travis Kelce's Florida condo reflects his family's real estate tiesKelce's connection to Florida comes through a property owned jointly with members of his family
The NFL star co-owns a condo in the Baldwin Park area of Orlando with his mother, Donna Kelce, and brother, Jason Kelce.The property has a family connection that goes beyond its market value
Donna, who is a full-time Florida resident, purchased the condo in May 2019 for $355,000.Property records indicate that nearly the entire Kelce family is included on the deed
Donna is listed first, while Travis and Jason are named as remaindermen.That ownership arrangement makes the Florida condo different from Travis' primary Kansas City residence

Rather than serving solely as his personal home, it is a shared family asset tied to the Kelces' long-standing connection to Florida.The condo also adds another location to the tight end's property portfolio, which includes his current mansion and his former Kansas City home.Although Kelce's real estate holdings are not as widely documented as those of some celebrity homeowners, the available details offer a glimpse into how he has invested beyond football.His Kansas City mansion stands as his primary residence, while the Florida condo represents a shared family investment
